editorial:
Imagine waking up from a long coma only to realize that someone you love tried to kill you. That is exactly what happens to the socialite in this tense thriller. You get to follow her as she tries to piece together her memory and figure out which family member is actually a monster in disguise. The vibe is very mysterious and keeps you guessing because everyone in her inner circle seems to have a secret reason to want her gone. It feels like a classic whodunit where the stakes are life and death.

The acting is solid and the plot moves along quickly without getting bogged down. You will love how the tension builds as she gets closer to the truth, though some of the 90s TV movie effects feel a bit dated now. If you enjoy a good mystery, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that a close family member was the one who attacked her to steal her wealth. After a scary final confrontation where the killer tries to finish the job, the socialite uses her wits to outsmart them. She manages to alert the police just in time. The movie ends with the villain being arrested and her finally finding peace and safety, knowing the predator is gone for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family secrets and murder mysteries.
